title: JipSMP Season 3
description: JipSMP Season 3 is a Minecraft SMP which includes a fancy economy system, along with extremely fast minecarts which facilitate an expansive railway network. This aims to replicate the vibe of old Minecraft SMPs before the elytra was added to the game.
body:
# JipSMP Season 3: Server with Economy and Fast Minecarts
## Notice:
You need to first join our discord server, and become whitelisted in order to join the minecraft server. This is to safeguard the healthy environment of the server.
**If you see the server is offline, it is because that we start the server only when we want to play.** Again, join the discord for more details.
## Specialty:
We have an extensive economy system which allows players to sell items for in-game money, which can be used for trading. Fast minecarts are also introduced to encourage railway construction and public transport, as opposed to elytras.
### This server is mainly regulated by mutual respect
Therefore, there are heavier consequences for rule violations. However, rules do not necessarily affect the freedom of gameplay.
We are a friendly community which is based on a minecraft server to chill and relax from everyday troubles. Feel free to join!
